# @three-ws/viewer-presets

> Tuned visual presets for three.ws avatar viewers — light rigs, floor reflection, bloom, and PBR material presets (chrome/gold/glass/…) with seeded variants.

@three-ws/viewer-presets is a JavaScript library from three.ws. Install: `npm install @three-ws/viewer-presets`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/viewer-presets/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/viewer-presets/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/viewer-presets/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/viewer-presets/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
